retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key profile portrait of a performer with dramatic rim lighting and a large area of dark negative space for stacked, left-aligned typography.
triggerTerms: soul album aesthetic with lens flare

recipe.visualDefinition: A side-profile shot of a male figure in a dark jacket, illuminated by a powerful white light source from the left that creates a strong rim light and a soft, hazy lens flare. The background is almost entirely black with a subtle magenta/purple color cast in the shadows. Typography is concentrated in the upper left quadrant, featuring a mix of lowercase geometric sans and large, outlined display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right facing a dominant light source on the left
Text block anchored to the top-left, balancing the subject's weight
High contrast between deep black shadows and blown-out highlights
coreInvariants: Strong rim lighting on the profile
Large area of dark negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right half of the frame in a medium close-up profile view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white light flare on the left edge acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the light source, follows the subject's gaze across the dark space, and then moves up to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the center and bottom-left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the primary light source and rim highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted magenta and purple tones in the mid-tones and shadow transitions.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blacks, whites, and deep purples

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for secondary text
Double-line or inline effect for primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Display 'J' and 'T' with extended horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between lowercase solid sans-serif and uppercase outlined display type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric lowercase aesthetic and 70s feel.
Provides the heavy, geometric uppercase structure for the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key profile portrait of a man in a dark jacket, facing left. Use a strong white light source on the far left to create a rim light on his face and shoulder, with a soft white lens flare. The rest of the image should be deep black with a subtle magenta tint in the dark areas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned text in the top-left corner. Use a lowercase geometric sans-serif for the top line, a large double-outlined uppercase sans-serif for the main name, and smaller magenta-colored sans-serif for the sub-text below.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with a visible rim light?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper-left quadrant?
Does the shadow area have a magenta/purple cast?
Is the main title text outlined rather than solid?

adjustableVariables: Strength of the magenta color cast
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Brand logos and record label marks
postGenerationChecks: Check for rim light consistency on the profile
Verify typography is left-aligned and stacked
Ensure the lens flare does not obscure the face
Confirm the magenta tint is subtle but present in shadows
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key profile + rim light + magenta shadows + top-left stacked geometric type.
